findings.evidence: Collar.lean:84-86, 137, 143, 197-199; the forward lemmas collarAmbientEquiv_apply_zero/_succ (:64-74) have no `symm` counterpart. `Equiv.piUnique.invFun := uniqueElim` (Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Defs.lean:563), `uniqueElim` defined by `rw [Unique.eq_default i]` (Mathlib/Logic/Unique.lean:224).
findings.fix: State and prove `collarAmbientEquiv_symm_apply_fst : ((collarAmbientEquiv n).symm y).1 = euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj n y` and `collarAmbientEquiv_symm_apply_snd_apply_zero : ((collarAmbientEquiv n).symm y).2 0 = y 0` (same `apply_symm_apply` + forward-simp-lemma pattern already used in Model.lean:195-222), plus a `0 ≤ ((collarAmbientEquiv n).symm y).2 0` lemma, and route all four sites through them instead of `exact`ing across the wrapper defeq.
findings.issue: No `collarAmbientEquiv_symm_*` lemmas exist, so every inverse-direction step is closed by defeq across wrappers. `collarHomeomorph_symm_apply_snd_apply_zero` (:143) proves a goal about `((collarAmbientEquiv n).symm y.1).2 0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)` by `exact euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv_symm_apply_snd n y.1`, whose statement is about a bare `ℝ`; this only typechecks by unfolding `ContinuousLinearEquiv.piUnique`/`Equiv.uniqueElim`/`WithLp`. Same class at :86 and :199 (`exact hnormal`, twice — the identical nonnegativity argument duplicated in `invFun` and in `contMDiff_invFun`) and :137 (`exact euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv_symm_apply_fst`). None carries a comment.

Both rely on `𝓡∂ k y` reducing to `y.1` without saying so.

findings.evidence: Collar.lean:87-99; `Prod.ext` used with component equalities at Mathlib/Data/Prod/Basic.lean:84, 221.
findings.fix: Drop the `change` and close with `Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h) (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd h))`; if the `change` really is required for elaboration, replace the comment with one stating why no rewrite reaches the goal.
findings.issue: `change` in `collarHomeomorph.left_inv` restates the goal only up to defeq of the anonymous-constructor fields (with `_` standing in for the membership proof). The comment says what it exposes, not why the goal cannot be reached otherwise; the following `hfst`/`hsnd` are already stated in the post-`change` form and `Prod.ext` takes `.1`/`.2` equalities, so the step looks removable.

summary: The forward direction of collarAmbientEquiv has characteristic lemmas, but the inverse direction has none: six proof steps close goals about `(collarAmbientEquiv n).symm` and the model coercions by undocumented definitional equality across the piUnique/WithLp and subtype wrappers. Also an unjustified `change` in `collarHomeomorph.left_inv`.
